overview: Jeremy Pang's Hong Kong Kitchen will follow Jeremy and friends around the great city, delving into the heart of Cantonese culture and its gastronomy. They're not there to simply scratch the surface, but to delve deep and reveal truly authentic emotional human stories and connections with food, plus meet the people who have played a key part in shaping Hong Kong's gastronomical landscape.
title: Jeremy Pang's Hong Kong Kitchen

overview: Join world renowned pastry chef Bernadette (Bets) Gee on a badass baking crash course as she teaches viewers how to perfect their pastry skills; explores staples like macarons, cake pops and more.
title: The Unruly Baker

overview: Ordained exorcist Ian Lawman is about to embark on his most personal and challenging case yet. This time he isn't cleansing a home or spooky location … he's going to the heart of the issue and tackling a suspected possessed person directly.
title: The Yorkshire Exorcist

overview: A unique production that travels to Planet Earth's major forests and jungles, providing a complete and unexpected view of their wildlife, biodiversity and importance for all life on our planet.
title: Planeta Selva

overview: On a remote island, Kian84 hosts a quirky B&B escape, where BTS' Jin and Ji Ye-eun lead guests through playful exploits and delightful chaos.
title: Kian's Bizarre B&B

overview: This documentary series follows Carlos Alcaraz as he balances the pressures of a phenomenal tennis career with a 20-year-old's desire to let loose.
title: Carlos Alcaraz: A mi manera

overview: Keep palm and carry on with Bermuda's island-hopping, crime-stopping police force. It's not all blue skies as crews aim to keep locals, tourists and famous faces safe.
title: Policing Paradise

overview: Two competing families try to outguess the opponents about survey results.
title: Une famille en or

overview: The main character is a talented and ambitious Valentina, who dreams of achieving success in science. However, her life turns upside down when she finds herself caught in the center of dangerous intrigues. On the eve of her 23rd birthday, Valentina faces betrayal by people she trusted. A close person fabricates accusations against her, causing her to lose everything: her fiancé, her family home, and the trust of those around her. Valentina embarks on a relentless struggle for justice and love, realizing that the most important thing along the way is not to lose her humanity.
title: Реванш

overview: My Happy Place invites viewers on an immersive excursion across the world anchored by an all-star cast of hosts including Emmy® and Tony® Award winning actor Alan Cumming; Academy Award® nominee and Golden Globe® winning actress Taraji P. Henson; award-winning actor Simu Liu; Grammy®, Emmy® and three-time Tony® Award winning performer Billy Porter; Academy Award® winning actress Octavia Spencer; and Academy Award® winning filmmaker and Grammy® winning musician Questlove. Across six visually stunning episodes, each host reflects on why these meaningful sites have become their escape, revealing a never-before-seen side of the person and the destination.
title: My Happy Place

overview: A biting exploration of power, class, seduction and culture set inside the glittering world of the high-end art market, told through the eyes of an aspiring super gallerist and the tangled relationship with her most gifted and unnerving artist.
title: The Dealer

overview: Bibaa & Nicole: Murder in the Park, unravelling the story behind the shocking killings of sisters Bibaa Henry and Nicole Smallman, and the police misconduct that followed. As the Covid lockdown began to ease in June 2020, a group of friends meet in a London park following Covid guidance to celebrate the birthday of 46-year-old Bibaa Henry. As darkness falls, the friends gradually leave the party, while sisters Bibaa and Nicole stay, dancing in the park. When they fail to return home, they are reported as missing, but their disappearance is not acted upon by the police and the search is left to friends and family. 36 crucial hours later, the bodies of Bibaa and Nicole are tragically found by Nicole's partner. Finally, the police take notice, but in a shocking development, the women's bodies are photographed and shared on social media by the police officers tasked with protecting the crime scene. Through moving interviews with the sisters' mother, Mina Smallman and the small group of family and friends at the centre of the search to find them, and insights from the murder detectives investigating the case, the series pieces together the sisters' final hours, the frantic hunt for a serial killer in the making, and the police misconduct that followed. With never-before-seen evidence and police recordings, the series offers a unique insight into the investigation, exposes the attitude behind the behaviour of the police, and examines the failures that left Bibaa and Nicole's loved ones fighting for answers.
title: Bibaa & Nicole: Murder in the Park

overview: The Girl Who Caught a Killer follows Rachael Watts, now 42, as she tells her extraordinary story – how, as a seven-year-old girl, she was kidnapped by a stranger, strangled, and left for dead. Four years earlier, the "Babes in the Wood" murders of schoolgirls Nicola Fellows and Karen Hadaway had shocked the nation. Despite the evidence, the killer Russell Bishop walked free – free to proclaim his innocence and, sickeningly, lead a hunt for the "real" killer. Rachael not only survived the appalling attack on her, but she was able to pick out her attacker from a police lineup. Bishop was found guilty of her attempted murder, and Rachael's identity remained a secret. Now, in this new two-part documentary series, Rachael breaks her thirty-year silence to share her story for the first time on camera, revealing the long-term impact of her trauma, and her role in helping convict a murderer. Alongside Rachael's story, family members of Nicola Fellows describe their thirty-year struggle for justice, leading to a sensational re-trial. Featuring the personal accounts of family, witnesses, police detectives, and with previously unreleased police footage and photos, the series gives unparallelled insight into one of the most notorious crimes in British history, how a second crime exposed the real killer, and how the testimony of one little girl finally caught a killer.
title: The Girl Who Caught a Killer

overview: The fourth instalment of the critically acclaimed and BAFTA winning Narcos series – Amsterdam Narcos. From the 1970s to the early 2000s, the Dutch city of Amsterdam transformed from a liberal countercultural haven into the drugs capital of Europe. What began as a government tolerating the hash trade soon opened the floodgates to organised crime, leaving the police playing catch up as ecstasy and cocaine smuggling followed. Amsterdam fuelled a pipeline of drugs and criminality through British ports, and right across Europe. As the Dutch underworld exploded and with the drugs trade spiralling out of control, law enforcement resorted to desperate measures in a bid to catch the gangsters. Told through the personal testimony of drug users, manufacturers, traffickers, and the detectives who tried to outsmart them, Amsterdam Narcos charts how underground rebellion escalated into an increasingly lethal, multi-billion-pound industry.
title: Amsterdam Narcos

overview: Teenager Sonya is a gifted sports shooter. When her brother and father are in danger because of their connections to the criminal world, she is forced to resolve the issue with the help of an old sniper rifle. Now she is suspected by the police and pursued by people thirsty for revenge. Sooner or later, she will have to shoot again...
title: Абсолютная сотня

overview: Causes and consequences of non-substance addictions consumed by teenagers through their cell phones' screens: social media, porn and online gaming.
title: Adictos a la pantalla

overview: For good or for bad, work is a fundamental aspect of human life. But it turns out that animals can't escape it, either! In Wild Workers, our protagonists need to work hard to survive: nature has its builders and refuse collectors, its musicians and gardeners and gravediggers, and even its thieves! So clock in for a full shift with this fresh and fun look at the way the animal world goes to work!
title: Wild Workers

overview: Honey goes deep undercover in 1980s East Berlin to explore a shadowy world of counter espionage and risky but irresistible relations. East Berlin, 1982. Martha, 24, is a deep cover agent for MI6. Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois. The risk of being garrotted or incarcerated is nothing compared to the horrifying ordeal of falling in love. Allowing yourself to be vulnerable and bearing your heart and soul? She'd rather have her fingernails ripped off.
title: Honey

overview: Eighteen adolescents between the ages of 14 and 17 have to study for two weeks in a sixties-style boarding school to obtain the diploma of middle school at that time.
title: Il collegio

overview: Three people play together on stage. There will only be one winner at the end, so the candidates compete against each other, but they always play the quiz in groups of three. If one person from the group answers correctly, all three players are still in the running. If no one answers, all three people are eliminated and are replaced by the next three in the queue. If one person buzzes and answers incorrectly, they are also eliminated and the next person in the queue takes their place. The other two players remain in the race and the game continues with the next question. There are 90 seconds to buzz after the question has been named. The answer time after the buzzer is five seconds. A total of 25 quiz questions are asked. The player who buzzes the fastest on the 25th question and names the correct answer wins 100,000 euros.
title: Ein sehr gutes Quiz (mit hoher Gewinnsumme)

overview: Presents nine eclectic tales of terror, each a unique nightmare ranging from dystopian futures to haunted space stations.
title: Horror Candy

overview: It is the spring of 1948. Twenty-four-year-old cook Josef Hasil serves in the kitchen of the National Security Corps in Zvonková. Wild boy. He had already experienced the war in a German labor camp and as a link between partisans.
title: Král Šumavy

overview: Jack Whitehall packs his bags for a comedy tour of the country, to find the best that Britain has to offer, joined along the way by celebrities and comedians.
title: Hit the Road Jack

overview: Marta is an incredibly intelligent and very individual woman who lacks respect for any authority. He wants nothing to do with the police at any cost. However, when, thanks to her uncontrollable desire to intervene in things and move them forward in an ingenious and innovative way, police chief Klára Hořavová offers her the position of consultant in the homicide department, she finally accepts after a short hesitation. Together with Captain Kreiner and his team, he begins to unravel complicated murder cases with his own personality. Czech adaptation of the 2021 French series HPI.
title: Případy mimořádné Marty

overview: The successful doctor Ondřej Frank wakes up in a reality he does not know at all. He must gradually discover and understand the world around him, but especially his own personality.
title: Chlap

overview: LUBACH is een satirisch magazine over het nieuws en actuele thema's. Met scherpe monologen, diepgravende verhalen en ludieke sketches maar ook met verrassende gasten, muziek en stand-up comedy.
title: Lubach

overview: Deals with a clash of values, when a child is taken away from a family because of an inappropriate name. Where does a person's personal freedom end and where does the social norm begin? Is it even possible to live outside the given system today?
title: Jitřní záře

overview: The series shows the environment of a live morning show, which it talks about with huge exaggeration. The morning show whose mission is to prepare viewers for the day ahead with a good mood. The show does not have it easy.
title: Dobré ráno, Brno!

overview: When Lise, the host of Denmark's morning TV show, meets the charming and adventurous Johannes, who lives a simple life in his van on the Danish coast, she faces the biggest dilemma of her life. Should she risk throwing away her successful career and marriage with co-host Martin in pursuit of adventure and true love? The choice is anything but easy, and Lise's life suddenly feels like great chaos. Chaos is a romantic and modern love story, which is about achievement and high expectations, not least of yourself, but also about having the courage to realise that happiness is in reality letting go of control and daring love, even when it comes inconveniently.
title: Chaos

overview: ITV1 and ITVX's unique new quiz show Win Win with People's Postcode Lottery will be the most interactive quiz show ever aired in the UK, as viewers playing from the comfort of their sofas get the chance to win the same truly amazing prizes as the contestants playing in studio. The series builds to an epic finale where one contestant is guaranteed to win £1,000,000 - and that winner could even be a viewer who made it through to the final. Created and produced by Hello Dolly and airing on Saturday nights for six weeks, comedy duo Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins will host, with each show packed with humour, drama and life-changing decisions. Playing survey questions based on the views of the Great British public, a 40-strong group of studio contestants, and viewers, play to win prizes including dream holidays, luxury cars, and tickets to some of the world's biggest sporting and entertainment events.
title: Win Win with People's Postcode Lottery

overview: Best friends Lex P and Drea Nicole from "Pour Minds" explore Charleston, Key West, Mexico City, and Cartagena, blending Lex's adventurous spirit with Drea's love for relaxation. They celebrate Black culture, uncover diverse experiences, and create balanced itineraries. Each episode is filled with humor, heart, and practical travel tips.
title: Travel Queens

overview: "Keep Cool My Babies!" Smart-alecky, ribald and whimsical, Late Night with Conan O'Brien rose to become a critical darling and dorm favorite after a rocky start in 1993. There are many recurring characters (including Triumph the Insult Comic Dog, Vomiting Kermit, Eyeballs O'Shaughnessy, NASCAR-driving gun-toting Jesus, Masturbating Bear) and comedy bits (including New State Quarters, What in the World, Celebrity Survey, Actual Items, Conan Hates My Homeland) that entertain us night after night. New episodes air Tuesday through Friday, with reruns on Mondays and occasional breaks where reruns air all week long. It airs weekdays at 12:37 a.m. ET/PT. (Simulcast in HDTV) Next-day encores air on CNBC at 7pm ET.
title: Late Night with Conan O'Brien

overview: Everyone dreams of a home makeover, but budgets often get in the way. Enter Kristen Coutts, who specializes in life-changing renovations for those told they can't afford them. Armed with clever, cost-saving hacks, she transforms outdated spaces into fresh, functional homes—proving no budget is too small for a stunning upgrade.
title: Beer Budget Reno

overview: During the turbulent years of Dawei, the realm remains divided. Prince Ning, Zhao He, leads his army to war and finds himself on the brink of death. Under imperial orders, the Office of Divination offers a rare medicinal slave to cure his poisoning. That slave, Yi Jiu, secretly the Saintess of the Moon Clan, uses herself as bait and becomes deeply entangled in a web of deception. In the end, Zhao He and Yun Yao work together to uncover the truth behind the Moon Clan's massacre. Together, they overcome life-and-death trials, stay true to their original purpose, and protect peace across the land.
title: The Antidote to Love

overview: Billy Joel: And So It Goes is an expansive portrait of the life and music of Billy Joel, exploring the love, loss, and personal struggles that fuel his songwriting. With unprecedented access to never-before-seen performances, home movies, and personal photographs, along with extensive, in-depth one-on-one interviews, the documentary intimately explores the life and work of Joel, whose music has endured across generations.
title: Billy Joel: And So It Goes

overview: The disgraced Empress Shen Miao dies unjustly in the cold palace, but unexpectedly returns to her teenage years. She sees the true, deceitful faces of those around her and sets out on a strong path of revenge, changing the tragic fate of the Shen family. During her quest, she meets the seemingly frivolous but secretly cunning and mysterious young Marquis Xie Jing Xing. From suspicion to alliance, they join forces to fight tyranny and restore peace.
title: Empress Reborn

overview: Examine the journey taken by NHL star Gabe Landeskog as he tries to return to the game he loves. A lingering right knee issue has sidelined Landeskog since June 26th, 2022.
title: A Clean Sheet: Gabe Landeskog
The Pond is Adorned with Blossoming Lotus

overview: In this immersive, gripping documentary, journalist Christo Grozev - famous for exposing Putin's murder machinery - discovers that he's under threat and goes on the run
title: Kill List: Hunted by Putin's Spies

overview: Presenter Emer Mhic an Fhailí has a passion for property and interior design. In Bog Amach she takes six couples and families to spectacular locations across the country as they search for the perfect place to settle. Each week we show our house-hunters three potential properties in their chosen area. As theyview houses, some ready to move into, others in need of a little more work, they get a sense ofjust how far their money can go. The search will throw up some unexpected challenges and some pleasant surprises.
title: Bog Amach

overview: Teacher Olga Golubeva gets hooked by scammers and now owes the bank three million. Her husband Vadim's plan to sell the village house is not working. Then Golubev's son Zhorik offers to create a farm, but not to grow vegetables, but money. After all, a village with cheap electricity is an ideal place for mining. All that remains is to hide this idea from the collectors, the village chairman and the school principal.
title: Киловаттино

overview: In this exclusive, original CuriosityStream documentary series, doctors, chefs and nutritionists weigh in on how changes in diet can positively affect health and longevity.
title: Prescription: Nutrition

overview: This wildlife series follows the trial the trials of three teams bringing wild birds of prey back to Ireland after an absence of over 100 years. It is the most important Irish wildlife story in decades - the return of some of the largest birds of prey ever to darken Irish skies, the White Tailed Eagle, the Golden Eagle and the Red Kite. From scaling cliffs in the wilds of Norway, Scotland and Wales on the hunt for new chicks, to hiring planes to fly them home, to nursing them through the first crucial months of freedom, the reintroduction involves a vast amount of work for a team of highly trained specialists. It follows their triumphs and tragedies as they track the birds from capture abroad through the first months of their release in Ireland. With radio & satellite tags, the guardians follow the released birds' progress across the country and wait and hope they will survive through their first winter. World-class wildlife photography, unfolding dramatic storylines, strong human & animal interest, important environmental, cultural and heritage themes - all combine to make this a compelling and important series with appeal for a very wide audience.
title: The Eagle's Return

overview: I‘m Maleika, the famous Cheetah, and I would like to share with you the stories of my fellow friends in the African continent. Africa is a place of beauty, grace, joy and hidden danger. Of course, it‘s just me who narrates the stories, but my kids are keen to be seen as well :). I believe that you will appreciate how I see the different animals that live close to us, and the good and bad moments that all of us are going through in these tough times.
title: Maleika's African Tales

overview: A collection of hilariously disturbing stories that push the boundaries of decency in ways only Tom Segura could imagine.
title: Bad Thoughts

overview: Fifth grade detectives Millie, Mike and Marta attempt to solve the never-ending mysteries of the fictional small Arkansas town of Mulberry Springs.
title: Mystery League

overview: Eddy, a math genius and small-time crook, avoids jail-time by going undercover as a teacher. His mission: to identify the kid of a major criminal.
title: Recalé

overview: Tilda is a young circus girl who saves her friend Arthur from the clutches of the Rev. Glasson. They escape across the West Country, finding new adventures at every turn.
title: True Tilda

overview: During the bright days of summer, two people became close friends, but they also parted with a vague emotion. After several autumns and winters, both him and his life have changed drastically. They meet again by chance, and this time, "he" doesn't want to let go again.
title: Our Golden Times

overview: This series is a fictional, fantasy, action adventure. A fantastic epic journey across the steppe around 800 BC with detailed history that mixes truth and fantasy in a mesmerizing way. Before Ghengis Khan, 33 total tribes of the Steppe united and rose against those that desecrated and mined their land, their descendants who would come to conquer the known world.
title: Тэгри Чину

overview: The strongest Women from all four corners of Ireland go head to head to be to be crowned the strongest in Ireland!
title: Ireland's Strongest Woman

overview: The untold stories and human tragedy behind Latin America's deadliest air disaster are investigated in this three-part documentary series.
title: Congonhas: Tragédia Anunciada

overview: The new socially acute consumer reality show on CHE! will show how things are behind the scenes of service. Uncompromising hosts, blogger Denis Volevoy and journalist Ekaterina Kashutchik, will study reviews on the Internet and, posing as clients, will conduct a thorough audit of popular establishments. Together, they will create their own quality navigator and tell viewers which doors are best not to enter.
title: Проверим всё

overview: Constables patrol the streets of Pennsylvania, deploying undercover schemes to lure people suspected of committing crimes out of hiding and serve them warrants.
title: Constables on Patrol

overview: Reality stars and everyday singles test their romantic chemistry in this live dating experiment hosted by Yvonne Orji.
title: Pop the Balloon LIVE

overview: When Rena and her family arrive in Colonia Le Baron, a secluded polygamist Mormon settlement in Mexico, they are commanded to relinquish all their earthly possessions and devote themselves to the doctrines of the LeBaron brothers, Ervil and Joel. However, as the brothers' insatiable thirst for power ignites growing discord, the community fractures, and Rena's family aligns with Ervil. As his teachings take a harrowing turn towards violence, Rena witnesses the transformation of devoted followers into ruthless killers, indoctrinated to carry out brutal acts. At just 16 years old, Rena becomes Ervil's 13th wife, groomed to serve as one of his so-called 'holy assassins'. After being coerced into committing murder against a rival polygamist, Rena miraculously escapes conviction, yet her fear for her life and her daughter's safety becomes palpable. When Ervil is unexpectedly arrested, Rena seizes the opportunity to escape the oppressive settlement, bringing her daughter and other loved ones with her. Driven by her harrowing experiences, she vows to help others break free from the confines of a life she never wanted.
title: The 13th Wife: Escaping Polygamy

overview: TG4's Travel series Téacs Taistil is back for its third season. This fun, quirky, and slightly chaotic adventure show has gone from strength to strength—kicking off with an epic first season, levelling up in season two, and now bringing you what we think is the best one yet. Every week, our three young, totally unique presenters are thrown headfirst into a mystery trip with just one mission: to show us—rain-soaked Irish people—where we should go and what we could do if we hopped on a plane, train, or automobile for a three-day adventure. With zero time to think, our travellers—Louise Cantillon, Séaghan Ó Súilleabháin, and Proinsias Ó Cuinn—get just 24 hours to pack, wax, and leg it to an unknown destination. From chasing the Northern Lights in Iceland to roaming the ancient walled city of Split, or even just braving the rickety roads of Cavan, our three highly competitive presenters have to throw themselves into the local way of life—all while waiting for their next set of text instructions. Where they stay, what they do, and how they eat? That's all decided by a mysterious texter. Over the past two seasons, they've steered boats across straits, shorn sheep on highlands, and even chiselled their own leather sandals—because why not? But season three takes things up a notch! For the first time, the gang is leaving Europe and getting lost in the sights, sounds, and madness of North Africa. They'll hit the fairgrounds in Seville, take a walk in the clouds over Bratislava, and learn some traditional skills in West Cork. So what's in store this time? What Insta-worthy moment will Louise capture? What TikTok trend will Séaghan jump on? And will Proinsias finally get over his fear of chickens? Join the Lad's as they embark on this fun adventure, creating memories to last a lifetime!
title: Téacs Taistil

overview: Each episode of the wildly entertaining series focuses on a competition in a different city from around the world, including London, Des Moines, Dallas, Edmonton, Johannesburg, Madrid and Sao Paolo. Everyday people will transform into daredevil engineers as they battle to be the fastest to the bottom of the nearly half-mile course. No two events are the same – every track presents distinct challenges, from water features to intimidating "bone rattler" and "final kicker" sections. Teams are judged not only on speed, but also on creativity and showmanship. Winners will take home a trophy along with the ultimate bragging rights.
title: Red Bull Soapbox Race

overview: March 2020. Pandemic. In a ghost-like Barcelona due to confinement, a homeless person is murdered while sleeping on the street. It will be the first of a series of crimes committed following the same pattern: always against homeless people, always while they sleep, and always with extreme violence. Agents of the Mossos d'Esquadra police force Quique Molina and Marga Muñoz, at odds with each other over something that happened in the past, will have the mission of finding a serial killer in the midst of a pandemic. A killer who acts like a virus: causing mortality and "infecting" other people who end up following his example. For this reason, the two agents will have to immerse themselves in the underworld of homeless people while Sergeant Molina's own life, in the midst of a divorce, is falling apart.
title: El Mal Invisible

overview: Alana Higman is sure that her family's lifelong history as Kansas City Chiefs superfans makes them a frontrunner to win the team's "Fan of the Year" contest. Derrick, Director of Fan Engagement, is tasked with evaluating how Alana and her family stack up against the other two finalists. As the pair spends time together, it's clear there's a spark between them but when her grandfather's vintage Chiefs good-luck winter hat goes missing, Alana begins to doubt everything she believed about fate, destiny and even questions her future with Derrick – unless, that is, a little Christmas magic can throw a Hail Mary.
title: Holiday Touchdown

overview: Loot Kaand follows the adventures of the siblings Latika and Palash in the small town of Purulia in West Bengal, where they plan a unique bank heist to save their ancestral house. But unbeknownst to them, dark and sinister forces beyond their control are at play and soon the siblings get trapped in a situation surrounded by vicious gangsters and corrupt policemen.
title: Loot Kaand

overview: Lo Tomas o Lo Dejas delivers heart-pounding excitement and suspense as participants navigate high-stakes decisions that could change their lives. With Paul Stanley's infectious energy guiding the action, viewers are in for a thrilling and engaging experience, where luck and a shrewd choice can lead to a $100,000 jackpot.
title: Lo Tomas o Lo Dejas

overview: Rose Ayling-Ellis: Old Hands, New Tricks follows Rose as she sets out to prove it's never too late to learn and embarks on a bold and heartfelt mission to transform the lives of a group of retirees by teaching them BSL. Her goal is to explore whether BSL can enhance their quality of life, deepen connections and combat the isolation that often comes with hearing loss.
title: Rose Ayling-Ellis: Old Hands, New Tricks

overview: You Can't Do That on Television featured pre-teen and teenaged actors in a sketch comedy format. Each episode had a specific theme normally relating to pop culture of the time.
title: You Can't Do That on Television

overview: Showcasing whānau, hapū and iwi-based enterprises that are putting Māori on the map.
title: Home, Land and Sea

overview: Planeta Tierra features in-depth coverage and analysis, investigative reports and on-the-ground reporting from cities across the United States and the Americas. It will include newsmaker interviews and thought-provoking conversations with innovators spearheading creative solutions to address the impact of today's changing climate. The weekly program will also feature regular contributions from Chief Meteorologist Carlos Robles and special reports from Telemundo local stations.
title: AHORA: Planeta Tierra

overview: Zhou Nanfeng travels back in time through a diary, arriving just before Qin Zhiyi's marriage falls apart, hoping to stop Zhong Ziye from seeking revenge on her. As their fates become entangled across timelines, Zhong Ziye relentlessly follows, manipulating events to create misunderstandings and drive a wedge between Zhou Nanfeng and Qin Zhiyi. But when Zhong Ziye unexpectedly dies and Zhou Nanfeng sacrifices himself to protect Qin Zhiyi, she finally uncovers the truth about the time travel. Using the diary once more, she journeys back again – only to realize that everything traces back to Zhong Ziye's love for Song Xingyue. As the four become trapped in an endless cycle of fate, love and hate intertwine, and the truth becomes ever more elusive, shrouded in blood and destiny.
title: The Future Lover

overview: Shu Yan, a young woman who has always put everyone before herself, has hit rock bottom after losing her family and career. She faces a string of devastating life changes, but as she regains her footing, she begins to rebuild herself and take control of her life. Through this transformative journey, she finds true love with Shen Weizhou.
title: Her Trajecting

overview: Criminal psychologist Lydia Benecke and profiler Stephan Harbort examine the mental states of historical serial killers, like Jack Unterweger, Guy Georges, Joanna Dennehy, Israel Keyes and others.
title: Erbarmungslos

overview: Aziz (20 years old) is a second-year IT student who starts to engage in Internet fraud to pay off his mother's debt. When he almost achieves his goal, he is exposed by his own teacher, Timur. In exchange for silence, Timur offers to join his own team of scammers and work on a large scale.
title: Admin

overview: A rich family, accustomed to a comfortable life, loses absolutely everything. They only have their father's house in the village, where they are forced to move and find a common language with a relative and with the local residents.
title: Salom Uka

overview: A coming of age story about a high-schooler, Sanjar, and his friends.
title: Maktab

overview: The Famous Jett Jackson is a joint Canadian and American Disney Channel Original Series coming-of-age television series for children about a boy named Jett Jackson who plays a teenage secret-agent on a fictional TV show-within-a-show called Silverstone. The Famous Jett Jackson was the first fictional Disney Channel Original Series. Jett Jackson was a kid actor who has his own show called "Silverstone". Seeking out a normal life, he moves back to his hometown of Wilsted, and has the show moved there. He and his two best friends, J.B. and Kayla, have all sorts of cool adventures along with his other friends Cubby, Riley, and maybe a bit of Nigel. Silverstone is a spy who works for Mission Omega Matrix (M.O.M), and goes on individual missions with his partner, Hawk, and his mentor, Artemus, and saves the world from villains like Dr. Hypnotto and The Rat.
title: The Famous Jett Jackson

overview: The events take place in 1994. Mukha, a well-known person in the criminal world, gets stabbed in the next fight and falls into the river. Internal affairs officers join his gang in order to catch actor Zakir Boho, who is his look-alike.
title: Toshkent 94

overview: An authoritative Almaty racketeer, after lying in a coma for 23 years, suddenly regains consciousness. To his horror he realizes that it is 2021, his children have grown up, he himself has aged and the world has changed beyond recognition.
title: Fara Tashkentskiy

overview: Halima (55 years old) sends her son Shokhrukh (25 years old) to study in America, he returns after studying, and says that he is bringing his daughter-in-law with him. Halima's joy knows no bounds, and she has already gathered all her relatives in the house. But when she sees Shokhrukh's chosen one, the mother is horrified - a dark-skinned girl, Julia, has arrived with her son.
